pages.text: Wear reading glasses in the head slot and aim at a displayed item. Details appear below the crosshair, including book titles, stack counts, and typesetting costs. The overlay respects locks and private titles.
All three wearable styles grant the same reading ability.

pages.title: Tinting Glasses
pages.text: Put a pair of ordinary reading glasses and gray dye in any two crafting slots. The tinted pair retains the original glasses’ name and enchantments.
The monocle provides the same readout.

pages.title: Enchanting a Helmet
pages.text: Enchant a book to obtain Reading, then use an anvil to apply it to head armor. Wear the enchanted armor for the same readout. Servers can disable the ability with the reading_glasses setting.
